create_GeneralizationTask: create a subclass of GeneralizationTask that implements sample_batch, input_size, and output_size
sample_batch_GeneralizationTask: sample a batch of inputs and outputs from a GeneralizationTask with given rng, batch_size, and length
compute_pointwise_loss: compute the pointwise cross-entropy loss between model output and target using pointwise_loss_fn
compute_accuracy: compute accuracy between model output and target using accuracy_fn with argmax comparison
generate_accuracy_mask: generate an accuracy mask from target tensor shape to exclude superfluous positions
